source_evidence: Player exact 'approach the contractor’s commander privately' authorizes arranging and attending a private conversation before the scheduled public meeting, no substantive V speech or concessions chosen. District organizer makes ordinary introduction; commander agrees to meet in small side room at ~14:25. Elara and Cirren willingly accompany as advisers, Mara and Fenar wait outside. Commander has independent plausible security motive, argues fragmented control and slow response are dangerous, wants unified authority over guild armory, asserts necessity rather than producing actual new lawful grant, invites alternative proposal that assures prompt defense readiness/accountability. Prepared OR-CR-CA private contractor overreach unchanged; no foreign link, invented extra forces, attack, key transfer, exposure, check, milestone or reward. V decides what to say. D315~14:25 Caereth guild district, private meeting in a small guildhall side room with private defense company's veteran commander, who agreed to talk before public meeting. V present with Elara and Cirren if they wish as independent witnesses/advisers; Mara and Fenar wait just outside with no hostile action, no active combat or tactical deployment. Commander knows V's request for private conversation, not V's Kestrel evidence or undisclosed guild strategy. He openly argues divided command and slow Assembly debate threaten city defense, asserts emergency necessity for unified custody of armory and stocks despite actual mandate not granting seizure; demands quartermaster hand over keys before/at meeting, willing to hear alternative if it provides real immediate readiness and accountable command. No admission of foreign sponsorship, no claim of new powers actually granted, no predetermined violence or agreement. V has not yet spoken substantive argument or threatened, shown documents or promised concessions. Quartermaster still holds armory keys and documents, scheduled meeting ~16:00 D315, civilian safety/legitimate access objective active.
